meetings.title: 1st Meeting 2026
meetings.summary: The first item on the agenda for today's meeting was to elect the Chairperson and the Deputy Chairperson of the Committee. Director, Legal Affairs, Uza. Afzaal Abdul Sattar facilitated the election of the Chairperson and the Deputy Chairperson of the Committee. Baarashu Constituency Member Ibrahim Shujau proposed to elect West Maafannu Constituency Member Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim as the Committee’s chair. This was seconded by Funadhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Mamdhooh. The Committee unanimously decided to elect West Maafannu Constituency Member Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim as the Chair of the Committee. (Voting details are provided in the “Votes” section of this page.) Baarashu Constituency Member Ibrahim Shujau proposed to elect Hoarafushi Constituency Member Ali Moosa as Deputy Chair of the Committee. This was seconded by Funadhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Mamdhooh. The Committee unanimously decided to elect Hoarafushi Constituency Member Ali Moosa as the Deputy Chair of the Committee. (Voting details are provided in the “Votes” section of this page.) Next, the Committee proceeded to set a deadline for the bill sent to the Committee. When the floor was opened to propose a deadline, Baarashu Constituency Member Ibrahim Shujau proposed 30 November 2026. This was seconded by Funadhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Mamdhooh. The Committee unanimously decided to set 30 November 2026 as the deadline for the bill. (Voting details are provided in the “Votes” section of this page.) The Committee then decided on the voting quorum and working quorum of the Committee and how to proceed with the bill sent to the committee. Baarashu Constituency Member Ibrahim Shujau proposed 12 members as both the voting and working quorums, and to give the deadline until 12 th November 2026 for the public and relevant authorities comments on the bill. This was seconded by Hoarafushi Constituency Member Ali Moosa. This proposal was unanimously passed by the members present and voted. (Voting details are provided in the “Votes” section of this page.)
